uses.description: Other declared modules that this module links (cmake/Project.cmake). Its tests link the uses closure; its fuzz targets compile the closure sources first. tools/project_model.py refuses an unknown name, the module itself and a cycle.

foundation.description: Opt-in: the module library links sc_foundation, sc_parallel and the locked GLib profile of each build (foundation.lock.json); fuzz targets of its uses closure build against the locked fuzz-profile GLib.

libraries.description: Shared libraries lib<name>.so made from the whole archives of the listed modules and their uses closure (cmake/Project.cmake, cmake/Safety.cmake). Every project module object is PIC; a version script exports only `exports`; the five non-instrumented builds link with -z defs and -z text. The hardened gate (tools/project_check.py) refuses a missing export, any other defined GLOBAL, WEAK or UNIQUE symbol, an undefined Py/_Py symbol, missing RELRO/BIND_NOW/non-executable stack or a text relocation, and a runtime closure whose GLib names do not resolve to the locked /opt/foundation/clang-O2/lib copy by sha256. Every project target links libm and compiles with -ffp-contract=off.
